## Change

Describe the behavior and linked ClickUp task(s).

## Validation

- [ ] npm ci
- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] RESULT and actual evidence linked; limitations explicit
- [ ] No secrets, production data or unintended schema changes

## QA review

State reproduction steps, expected results and remaining gaps. Do not merge until QA approves and required checks pass.
